messages:
incident-bot: Pager: [PROD] decode-service (prod-decode-us-west-7) GPU OOM spike detected, 7 nodes impacted, triggering quorum page. Priority: P1.
ops-bot: Auto-rotations applied: cordon node-gpu-07, quarantined 2 pods.
katie_oncall: Acknowledged — I'm on it. Collecting recent logs and tailing /var/log/decode/runtime.log.
sam_sre: Seen a sudden surge of long-running streams with no `max_tokens` header. Likely runaway generation from a client. Checking ingress telemetry.
maria_ml: ML note: models running are redwood/gptx-3.2q and redwood/gptx-3.2-q4 for fallbacks. If KV cache grows unbounded we hit CUDA OOM quickly.
chris_engineer: Quick stats from router: 5m error rate to decode-service = 2.1%, dropped requests ~1.8k, avg latency spike to 1.2s for token churn. Top offending route: /v1/stream_generate with missing maxtokens in 78% of failing requests.
katie_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) enqueue immediate per-route soft cap to 512 tokens at edge 2) enable defensive max_tokens enforcement in decode-service config 3) restart contested pods after draining. Doing step 1 now.
ops-bot: Edge rule applied: add header-enforced limit X-Request-MaxTokens=512 for /v1/stream_generate.
sam_sre: Applying runtime guard patch: short-circuit generation if token_count > config.max_tokens OR if generation loops > 2048 iterations. Pushing hotpatch to canary. Command: ```kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/decode-canary```
maria_ml: Canary patch logs show behavior: one runaway client produced continuous outputs until we killed the stream. Kernel error seen right before OOM: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` then `cudaMemcpy` failure and subsequent c10::OutOfMemoryError.
aditya_platform: Coordinating node rotation: scaling up fallback pool by +3 gpus to absorb new routed traffic, and draining node-gpu-07. Run: ```k8s-scale --cluster prod --pool decode-fallback +3```
katie_oncall: Restarting 3 pods now, draining flagged node. Expect ~30s reduce per-pod memory.
chris_engineer: Customer impact: two enterprise customers reported intermittent request failures. CS notified. Preparing postmortem blurb.
sam_sre: After guard in canary, OOMs reduced to zero on canary. Rolling patch to 30% of decode fleet. Suggest automated header fallback and default max_tokens enforcement at edge permanently.
maria_ml: Short-term: enable strict quantized fallback (gptx-3.2-q4) for streams that exceed token thresholds to reduce per-token memory.
ops-bot: Quarantine summary: node-gpu-07 cordoned, pods rescheduled, GPU mem fragmentation cleared on node rotation.
katie_oncall: TL;DR: cause = client-side missing/incorrect max_tokens causing runaway streaming -> KV cache growth -> CUDA OOM -> pod crashes and request drops. Mitigations applied: edge soft-cap, runtime guard hotpatch, canary -> 30% rollout, scale fallback pool, cordon/drain affected node.
aditya_platform: Handing off to next on-call @sam_sre in 20m for verification and rollout completion. Please update incident timeline.
chris_engineer: Noted for customer comms: estimated % of requests dropped globally during 12:34–12:46 UTC = ~0.9%, peak error window had 1.8k drops, affected tenants: T-Alpha and T-Gamma.
katie_oncall: Adding followups: - schedule postmortem with ML/Runtime/Edge teams - add automated token-guard at edge for all streaming routes - instrument TTL on KV entries to bound memory.
sam_sre: Acknowledged takeover. Will watch for regressions and finish 100% rollout if stable for 15m.
incident-bot: Incident state changed to MONITORING. Pager cleared.
summary: GPU OOM from runaway streaming due to missing max_tokens; applied edge caps, runtime hotpatch, scaled fallback pool, cordoned node, handed to next on-call
